chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When you head towards Mina, say: O Allah, to You alone I hope and to You alone I supplicate, so grant me my desire and rectify my deed for me."

key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a sacred site near Mecca used during Hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite when heading to Mina during Hajj?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on staying in Mina, this hadith prescribes a concise du'a emphasizing exclusive reliance on Allah (tawakkul) and the alignment of one's deeds with divine will. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on integrating spiritual intention with ritual action during the Hajj journey, ensuring that the pilgrim’s aspirations are sanctified by God's approval.
